text: Dasatinib is a potent, multi-targeted tyrosine kinase inhibitor that binds to the ATP-binding pocket of the BCR-ABL fusion protein—the constitutively active kinase driving Chronic Myeloid Leukemia (CML)—as well as the SRC family kinases. By stabilizing the inactive conformation of the kinase domain, Dasatinib effectively blocks the transfer of phosphate groups to downstream signaling substrates, thereby inhibiting the proliferative and anti-apoptotic pathways essential for leukemic cell survival. With a binding affinity significantly higher than first-generation inhibitors (IC50 in the sub-nanomolar range), Dasatinib overcomes resistance caused by most BCR-ABL mutations, providing a robust therapeutic rationale for treating patients who are intolerant or resistant to Imatinib.
